name: UA YANG Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: UA YANG Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive development, production, and distribution of high-precision optical instruments. Their product portfolio encompasses automated optical inspection (AOI) systems, precision optical measurement devices, integrated optical solutions, and advanced image detection modules. The company commenced operations on October 9, 2012, and its principal location is in Tainan, Taiwan.
